name: benchmark_single_cube_v2
description: A dataset/benchmark centered on tasks involving a single cube, intended to measure models' abilities in core visual/robotic perceptions such as object detection, pose estimation, and action/trajectory prediction for cube manipulation. Tasks typically require interpreting visual observations to predict cube state or next actions and are useful for evaluating perception-to-action pipelines.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside niche vision/robotics experimentation.
